units.zh: 歷代天文誌，自《史記·天官書》後，唯晉、隋兩誌，備述天體、儀象、星占，唐、宋加詳，皆未盡也。
units.en: Dynastic astronomy monographs after Sima Qian's Heavenly Offices are fully descriptive only in the Jin and Sui versions; Tang and Song expanded them, but gaps remain.
units.literal: Astronomical treatises of successive dynasties, after the Records of the Grand Historian's Treatise on the Heavenly Offices, only the Jin and Sui treatises fully describe celestial bodies, instruments, and star divination; the Tang and Song added detail, yet none is complete.

units.zh: 至元，景測益精明，占候較密，然疆宇所囿，聲教未宏，齊政窺璣，尚多略焉。
units.en: Yuan observers refined instruments and tightened forecasts, but within a limited empire their cosmological governance still fell short.
units.literal: Under the Yuan, instrumental observation grew more precise and prognostication denser, yet the realm they enclosed and cultural sway they spread were not broad; aligning government with the celestial pivot still left much omitted.

units.zh: 有清統一區夏，聖聖相承。
units.en: The Qing unified China, one sage emperor following another.
units.literal: The Qing unified All-under-Heaven, sage succeeding sage.

units.zh: 聖祖親釐象數，究極精微，前後制新儀七，測日月星辰，則窮極分秒；
units.en: The Kangxi emperor personally mastered calendrical astronomy, devised seven new instruments, and measured the sun, moon, and stars to the second.
units.literal: The Sacred Ancestor personally rectified numerology and celestial phenomena, penetrating the utmost subtlety; before and after he devised seven new instruments; in measuring sun, moon, and stars he exhausted fractions of seconds;

units.zh: 度輿圖經緯，則穹歷幅隕。
units.en: In surveying terrestrial longitude and latitude, he covered every corner of the realm.
units.literal: in surveying the maps' longitude and latitude, he traversed every corner of the realm.

units.zh: 世宗復以歲久積差，準監臣改用橢圓術。
units.en: Yongzheng, seeing accumulated error over the years, had supervising astronomers adopt elliptical theory.
units.literal: The Shizong Emperor again, because long years had accumulated discrepancy, ordered supervising officials to adopt the elliptical method.

units.zh: 高宗又以舊記星紀，間有疏漏，御製璣衡撫辰儀，重加測候。
units.en: Qianlong, finding gaps in older star catalogs, built the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and remeasured the sky.
units.literal: The Gaozong Emperor again, because old star records had occasional gaps, personally made the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and took new observations.

units.zh: 迨平定回疆及兩金川，復令重度裏差，增入時憲。
units.en: After pacifying Xinjiang and the two Jinchuan campaigns, he ordered li-cha remeasured and entered into the Shixian calendar.
units.literal: When the Muslim borderlands and the Two Jinchuan were pacified, he again ordered remeasurement of li-cha and added the results to the Time Constitution calendar.

units.zh: 理明數確，器精法密，自古以來，所未有也。
units.en: Clarity of principle, exactitude of number, refinement of instrument, and density of method were unmatched in earlier ages.
units.literal: Principles clear, numbers exact, instruments refined, methods dense—from antiquity there has never been the like.

units.zh: 今為天文誌，備載推驗之法，其天象昭垂，見於歷朝實錄及所司載記者，亦悉書之。
units.en: This Astronomy Treatise records computational methods and every celestial phenomenon noted in dynastic Veritable Records and observatory logs.
units.literal: Now for the Astronomy Treatise we fully record methods of computation and verification; celestial phenomena manifest overhead, as seen in successive dynasties' Veritable Records and the offices' records, are also all written.

units.zh: 乾隆六十年以後，國史無徵，則從闕焉。
units.en: After Qianlong 60 the Veritable Records offer no material, so the account stops there.
units.literal: After Qianlong year 60 the National History has no testimony, and those years are therefore omitted.

units.zh: 天象地體裏差
units.en: Celestial Phenomena, Earth's Form, and Li-Cha
units.literal: Celestial Phenomena, Earth's Form, and Li-Cha

units.zh: 天象歷象考成天象篇云：「《楚辭·天問》曰：『圜則九重，孰營度之？』
units.en: The Compilation of Heavenly Phenomena quotes: "The Chu Ci Heavenly Questions says: 'The heavens are ninefold round — who designed and measured them?'
units.literal: Celestial Phenomena and Calendrical Phenomena, Compilation of Heavenly Phenomena says: "The Chu Ci, Heavenly Questions, says: 'Round then ninefold — who planned and measured it?'

units.zh: 後世歷家，謂天有十二重，非天實有如許重數，蓋言日月星辰運轉於天，各有所行之道，即楚辭所謂圜也。
units.en: Later astronomers spoke of twelve celestial spheres not as literal shells but as the separate paths of sun, moon, and stars — the "round" of the Chu Ci.
units.literal: Later calendar specialists said heaven has twelve layers; heaven does not truly have so many layers — it speaks of sun, moon, and stars revolving in heaven, each with its own path — that is what the Chu Ci calls round.

units.zh: 欲明諸圜之理，必詳諸圜之動，欲考諸圜之動，必以至靜不動者準之，然後得其盈縮。
units.en: To understand celestial spheres one must study their motion against an absolutely fixed reference; only then can expansion and contraction be calculated.
units.literal: To clarify the principles of the spheres one must detail their motions; to examine their motions one must take what is utterly still and unmoving as standard — then one obtains their waxing and waning.

units.zh: 蓋天道靜專者也，天行動直者也。
units.en: Heaven's Way is still and single-minded; its motion is active and direct.
units.literal: For the Way of Heaven is still and dedicated; heaven's motion is active and upright.

units.zh: 至靜者自有一天，與地相為表裏，故群動者運於其間而不息。
units.en: An absolutely fixed heaven pairs with earth as inner and outer; all moving bodies wheel within it unceasingly.
units.literal: The utterly still has a heaven of its own, inner and outer garment with earth, hence the many movers operate within it without cease.

units.zh: 若無至靜者以驗至動，則聖人亦無所成其能矣。
units.en: Without a fixed frame against which to measure motion, even the sage could not perfect his art.
units.literal: If there were no utterly still by which to verify the utmost motion, the sage would have no means to accomplish his skill.

units.zh: 人恒在地面測天，而七政之行無不可得者，正為以靜驗動故也。
units.en: Observers stand on earth yet can chart the seven luminaries because motion is measured against what does not move.
units.literal: Humans always measure heaven from earth's surface, yet the seven luminaries' motions can all be obtained — precisely because still verifies motion.

units.zh: 「十二重天，最外者為至靜不動；
units.en: Of the twelve spheres, the outermost is absolutely fixed;
units.literal: The twelve-layer heaven — outermost is utterly still and unmoving;

units.zh: 次為宗動，南北極赤道所由分也。
units.en: next the primum mobile, which defines the poles and equator;
units.literal: next is the primum mobile, where north and south poles and the equator are divided;

units.zh: 次為南北歲差；
units.en: next north-south precession;
units.literal: next is north-south precession;

units.zh: 次為東西歲差；
units.en: next east-west precession;
units.literal: next is east-west precession;

units.zh: 此二重天，其動甚微，歷家姑置之而不論焉。
units.en: these two spheres move imperceptibly and astronomers usually ignore them.
units.literal: these two heavens move very slightly; calendar specialists provisionally set them aside and do not discuss them.

units.zh: 次為三垣二十八宿，經星行焉。
units.en: next the Three Enclosures and Twenty-eight Mansions where fixed stars travel;
units.literal: next are the Three Enclosures and Twenty-eight Mansions, through which the fixed stars pass;

units.zh: 次為填星所行；
units.en: next Saturn's sphere;
units.literal: next that where Saturn moves;

units.zh: 次為歲星所行；
units.en: next Jupiter's;
units.literal: next where Jupiter moves;

units.zh: 次為熒惑所行；
units.en: next Mars's;
units.literal: next where Mars moves;

units.zh: 次則太陽所行，黃道是也。
units.en: next the sun's ecliptic;
units.literal: next where the Sun moves — the ecliptic;

units.zh: 次為太白所行；
units.en: next Venus's;
units.literal: next where Venus moves;

units.zh: 次為辰星所行；
units.en: next Mercury's;
units.literal: next where Mercury moves;

units.zh: 最內者則太陰所行，白道是也。
units.en: innermost the moon's white path.
units.literal: innermost where the Moon moves — the white path.

units.zh: 要以去地之遠近而為諸天之內外，然所以知去地之遠近者，則又從諸曜之掩食及行度之遲疾而得之。
units.en: Near and far are ranked by distance from earth, known from mutual occultations, eclipses, and relative speed in degrees.
units.literal: Essentials: by distance from earth as inner and outer of the heavens; yet how one knows distance from earth is again from the luminaries' occultations and eclipses and from degrees' slowness and speed.

units.zh: 蓋凡為所掩食者必在上，而掩之食之者必在下。
units.en: The body eclipsed lies above; the eclipser below.
units.literal: For whatever is occulted or eclipsed must be above; what occults or eclipses must be below.

units.zh: 月體能蔽日光而日為之食，是日遠月近之徵也。
units.en: The moon blocks the sun in eclipse, proving the sun farther than the moon.
units.literal: The moon's body can obscure sunlight and the sun is eclipsed — a sign the sun is far and the moon near.

units.zh: 月能掩食五星，而月與五星又能掩食恒星，是五星高於月而卑於恒星也。
units.en: The moon occults the five planets; moon and planets occult fixed stars — planets stand above the moon but below the fixed stars.
units.literal: The moon can occult the five stars, and moon and five stars can occult fixed stars — the five stars are higher than the moon yet lower than fixed stars.

units.zh: 五星又能互相掩食，是五星各有遠近也。」
units.en: The five planets also occult one another, each at a different distance."
units.literal: The five stars can also mutually occult one another — each has its own near and far."

units.zh: 「又宗動天以渾灝之氣挈諸天左旋，其行甚速。
units.en: "The primum mobile, by vast ethereal force, drags all spheres in daily rotation — very fast.
units.literal: "Also the primum mobile heaven, with vast qi, carries all heavens in left rotation; its motion is very swift.

units.zh: 故近宗動天者，左旋速而右移之度遲。
units.en: Near it, daily rotation is fast and apparent retrograde motion slow.
units.literal: Hence near the primum mobile heaven, left rotation is swift and rightward shift slow.

units.zh: 漸遠宗動天，則左旋較遲而右移之度轉速。
units.en: Farther out, daily rotation slows and retrograde motion quickens.
units.literal: Gradually farther from the primum mobile, left rotation is slower and rightward shift faster.

units.zh: 今右移之度，惟恒星最遲，土木次之，火又次之。
units.en: Retrograde speed ranks fixed stars slowest, then Saturn and Jupiter, then Mars.
units.literal: Now for rightward shift: only fixed stars are slowest, Saturn and Jupiter next, Mars again next.

units.zh: 日、金、水較速而月最速，是又以次而近之證也。」
units.en: The sun, Venus, and Mercury move faster; the moon fastest — another proof of nearness."
units.literal: Sun, Venus, and Mercury are faster and the moon fastest — again proof by successive nearness."

units.zh: 考成後編日躔歷理云：「西法自多祿某以至第谷，立為本天高卑、本輪、均輪諸說，近世刻白爾、噶西尼等，又以本天為橢圓。」
units.en: The Daily Solar Motion Treatise notes: "From Ptolemy through Tycho came deferents, epicycles, and eccentrics; Kepler and Cassini made the deferent elliptical."
units.literal: Post-Compilation Daily Solar Motion Treatise says: "Western method from Ptolemy to Tycho established deferent heights, epicycle, and eccentric theories; recent Kepler, Cassini, and others took the deferent as an ellipse."

units.zh: 月離歷理云：「自西人創為橢圓之法，日距月天最高有遠近，則太陰本天心有進退。
units.en: The Lunar Distance Treatise adds: "Elliptical theory makes the sun's distance from the lunar sphere vary and the lunar deferent center oscillate.
units.literal: Lunar Distance Treatise says: "Since Westerners created the ellipse method, the sun's distance from the lunar heaven at apogee has near and far, and the moon's deferent center has advance and retreat.

units.zh: 地心與天心相距，兩心差有大小。」
units.en: Earth center and celestial center diverge by a measurable interval."
units.literal: Earth center and heaven center are apart; the two centers' difference has magnitude."

units.zh: 合觀諸論，天象備矣。
units.en: Taken together, these accounts complete the picture of celestial phenomena.
units.literal: Viewing all discussions together, celestial phenomena are complete.

units.zh: 恒星天無地半徑差及次輪消息，故誌土星以下七天距地心數，著考測之詳焉。
units.en: Fixed stars show no parallax or epicycle variation; below Saturn the treatise lists each planet's distance from earth's center from survey data.
units.literal: The fixed-star heaven has no earth-radius difference or secondary-cycle variation, so the treatise records from Saturn downward the seven heavens' distances from earth center, detailing survey particulars.

units.zh: 諸天距地心數：
units.en: Distances from earth center:
units.literal: Distances of the heavens from earth center:

units.zh: 土星最高一十一又一百零四萬二千六百分之三十五萬二千六百日天半徑；
units.en: Saturn apogee: 11 + 1,042,626/352,606 solar radii;
units.literal: Saturn at highest: eleven and 1,042,626/352,606 solar radii;

units.zh: 木星最高六又一百九十二萬九千四百八十分之一百三十萬五千九百日天半徑；
units.en: Jupiter apogee: 6 + 1,929,408/1,305,590 solar radii;
units.literal: Jupiter at highest: six and 1,929,408/1,305,590 solar radii;

units.zh: 火星最高二又六百三十萬二千七百五十分之五百五十五萬二千二百五十日天半徑；
units.en: Mars apogee: 2 + 6,302,705/5,552,250 solar radii;
units.literal: Mars at highest: two and 6,302,705/5,552,250 solar radii;

units.zh: 日均輪術最高一千一百六十二地半徑，橢圓術最高二萬零九百七十五地半徑；
units.en: Sun: mean epicycle 1,162 earth radii; ellipse 20,975 earth radii;
units.literal: Sun — mean epicycle method at highest: 1,162 earth radii; ellipse method at highest: 20,975 earth radii;

units.zh: 金星最高高於日一千萬分日天半徑之七百五十四萬五千六百四十四，最下下於日如之；
units.en: Venus apogee: 7,545,644/10,000,000 solar radius above the sun; perigee equally below;
units.literal: Venus at highest above the sun: 7,545,644/10,000,000 of a solar radius; at lowest below the sun by the same amount;

units.zh: 水星最高高於日一千萬分日天半徑之四百五十三萬二千一百五十五，最下下於日如之；
units.en: Mercury apogee: 4,532,155/10,000,000 solar radius above the sun; perigee equally below;
units.literal: Mercury at highest above the sun: 4,532,155/10,000,000 of a solar radius; at lowest below the sun by the same amount;

units.zh: 月均輪術最高朔望時五十八又百分之一十六地半徑，橢圓術最高六十三又百分之七十七地半徑。
units.en: Moon: mean epicycle 58.16 earth radii at syzygy; ellipse 63.77 earth radii.
units.literal: Moon — mean epicycle method at highest at new and full moon: fifty-eight and 16/100 earth radii; ellipse method at highest: sixty-three and 77/100 earth radii.

units.zh: 地體渾天家謂天包地如卵裹黃，內經：「黃帝曰：『地之為下否乎？』
units.en: On earth's form: armillary cosmologists say heaven encloses earth like a shell around a yolk. The Inner Classic records: "The Yellow Emperor asked, 'Is earth truly below?'
units.literal: Earth's body — armillary-sphere cosmologists say heaven wraps earth like an egg wrapping the yolk; Inner Classic: "Yellow Emperor said: 'Is earth truly below?'

units.zh: 岐伯曰：『地為人之下，太虛之中也。』
units.en: Qibo answered, 'Earth lies below humanity, suspended in the Great Void.'
units.literal: Qibo said: 'Earth is below man, within the Great Void.'

units.zh: 曰：『憑乎？』
units.en: The emperor asked, 'On what does it rest?'
units.literal: He said: 'Resting on what?'

units.zh: 曰：『大義舉之也。』」
units.en: Qibo said, 'The Great Principle holds it up.'"
units.literal: He said: 'The Great Principle lifts it.'

units.zh: 大戴禮：「單居離問於曾子曰：『天圓而地方，誠有之乎？』
units.en: The Great Dai Rites records: "Danju Li asked Zengzi, 'Heaven is round and earth square — is that true?'
units.literal: Great Dai Rites: "Danju Li asked Zengzi: 'Heaven round and earth square — is it truly so?'

units.zh: 曾子曰：『如誠天圓而地方，則是四角之不掩也。
units.en: Zengzi replied, 'If heaven were truly round and earth square, the corners would not meet.
units.literal: Zengzi said: 'If heaven were truly round and earth square, the four corners would not meet.

units.zh: 參嘗聞諸夫子曰：「天道曰圓，地道曰方。」』」
units.en: I once heard from the Master: "Heaven's Way is called round; earth's Way is called square."'"
units.literal: I once heard the Master say: "Heaven's Way is called round; earth's Way is called square."'"

units.zh: 宋儒邵子曰：「天何依？
units.en: Shao Yong of the Song asked, "On what does heaven rely? On earth.
units.literal: Song Neo-Confucian Shao Yong said: "On what does heaven rely? On earth;

units.zh: 依乎地；
units.en: It relies on earth;
units.literal: It relies on earth;

units.zh: 地何附？
units.en: On what does earth attach?
units.literal: On what does earth attach?

units.zh: 附乎天。
units.en: To heaven.
units.literal: To heaven.

units.zh: 天地何所依附？
units.en: On what do heaven and earth attach to each other?
units.literal: On what do heaven and earth mutually attach?

units.zh: 自相依附。
units.en: They attach to each other.
units.literal: They attach to each other.

units.zh: 自相依附，天依形，地附氣。」
units.en: Mutually attaching: heaven by form, earth by qi."
units.literal: Mutually attaching — heaven by form, earth by qi."

units.zh: 程子曰：「據日景以三萬里為中，若有窮，然有至一邊已及一萬五千里，而天地之運蓋如初。
units.en: Cheng Yi said, "By gnomon shadow, thirty thousand li marks the center; it seems finite, yet at fifteen thousand li on one side heaven and earth still move as before.
units.literal: Cheng Yi said: "By the sun's shadow, thirty thousand li as center — it seems bounded, yet when one side has already reached fifteen thousand li, heaven and earth's motion is as at first.

units.zh: 然則中者亦時中耳。」
units.en: The center is only the center for a given moment."
units.literal: Then the center is also a temporal center."

units.zh: 又曰：「今人所定天體，只是且以眼定，視所極處不見，遂以為盡。
units.en: He also said, "People define the heavens only by sight — where the eye stops, they call that the edge.
units.literal: He also said: "What people now fix as the celestial body is only by the eye — where vision ends they take as the limit.

units.zh: 然向曾有於海上見南極下有大星十，則今所見天體蓋未定。
units.en: Yet at sea ten bright stars appeared south of the pole, so our celestial map remains uncertain.
units.literal: Yet once at sea one saw ten large stars below the south pole; today's fixed celestial body is therefore unsettled.

units.zh: 日月升降，不過三萬里中，然而中國只到鄯善、沙車，已是一萬五千里。
units.en: The sun and moon move within thirty thousand li of center, while China reaches only Shanshan and Yarkand — half that span.
units.literal: Sun and moon rise and set only within thirty thousand li at center; yet China reaches only Shanshan and Yarkand — already fifteen thousand li.

units.zh: 若就彼觀日，尚只是三萬里中也。
units.en: From there the sun would still appear at the same central distance.
units.literal: Viewed from there the sun would still lie within thirty thousand li of center.

units.zh: 伯淳在澤州，嘗三次食韭黃，始食懷州韭，次食澤州，次食并州，則知數百里間，氣候已爭三月矣。
units.en: At Zezhou, Bochun ate chives three times — from Huai, Ze, and Bing — and found climate three months apart within hundreds of li.
units.literal: Bochun at Zezhou once ate chive shoots three times — first Huai chives, then Ze chives, then Bing chives — and knew that within a few hundred li climate already differed by three months.

units.zh: 若都以此差之，則須爭半歲。
units.en: Extrapolated, the difference would reach half a year.
units.literal: If one extrapolated by that difference, it would amount to half a year.

units.zh: 如是，則有在此冬至、在彼夏至者，只是一般為冬夏而已。」
units.en: One place could have winter solstice while another had summer solstice — merely opposite seasons."
units.literal: Thus there could be winter solstice here and summer solstice there — only the names winter and summer would differ."

units.zh: 朱子天問註云：「天之形圓如彈丸，其運轉者亦無形質，但如勁風之旋。
units.en: Zhu Xi's Heavenly Questions commentary: "Heaven is round like a pellet; its rotation has no solid body, only a whirl of fierce wind.
units.literal: Zhu Xi's commentary on Heavenly Questions says: "Heaven's form is round like a pellet; what rotates also has no substance, but is like a fierce wind's whirl.

units.zh: 地則氣之渣滓聚成形質者，但以其束於勁風旋轉之中，故得以兀然浮空甚久而不墮耳。」
units.en: Earth is condensed qi, held aloft in that whirl so long that it seems to float without falling."
units.literal: Earth is the dregs of qi gathered into form, but because it is bound within the fierce wind's rotation it can alone float in the void long without falling."

units.zh: 西人謂地體渾圓，四面皆有人，冬夏互異，晝夜相反，與內經、戴記及宋儒之言若合符節。
units.en: Westerners hold the earth a perfect sphere with inhabitants on every side, opposite seasons and reversed day and night — matching the Inner Classic, Dai Rites, and Song masters.
units.literal: Westerners say earth's body is perfectly round, with people on all four sides; winter and summer differ and day and night reverse — matching the Inner Classic, the Dai Rites, and Song Confucians as if tallying seal and notch.

units.literal: Now tested against heaven's circumference of three hundred sixty degrees: traveling two hundred li south lowers the north pole one degree;

units.zh: 其在赤道南北緯圈下行，雖廣狹不同，然莫不應乎渾象。
units.en: Movement along parallels north and south of the equator, though distances vary by latitude, matches the armillary model.
units.literal: Traveling along latitude circles north and south of the equator, though the spans differ in width and narrowness, all accord with the armillary sphere.

units.zh: 則知地之大周皆三百六十度，東西南北皆周七萬二千里，以古尺八寸計之，則周九萬里；
units.en: Earth's full circumference is 360°, 72,000 li in every direction; by the ancient 8-cun foot that is 90,000 li around;
units.literal: Then one knows earth's great circumference is three hundred sixty degrees, east-west and north-south each seventy-two thousand li; by the ancient eight-cun foot it is ninety thousand li in circumference;

units.zh: 以圍三徑一率之，則徑三萬里；
units.en: with pi as 3, diameter 30,000 li;
units.literal: by circumference three and diameter one, diameter thirty thousand li;

units.zh: 亦與古三萬里為中之說相符。
units.en: matching the old doctrine of 30,000 li to the center.
units.literal: this also matches the ancient saying of thirty thousand li as center.

units.zh: 然則地體渾圓，無疑義矣。
units.en: Earth is therefore certainly a sphere.
units.literal: Thus earth's body is perfectly round — beyond doubt.

units.en: Li-cha ("li difference") names the shift in zenith and horizon when observers stand at different longitudes and latitudes; it matters greatly for what one sees overhead.
units.literal: Li-cha arises because where people dwell differs in north, south, east, and west — the zenith and horizon also differ — and can be fixed by computing li; hence the name li-cha; its bearing on observations overhead is very great.

units.zh: 蓋恒星之隱見，晝夜之永短，七曜之出沒，節氣之早晚，交食之深淺先後，莫不因之而各殊。
units.en: Star visibility, day length, planetary risings, seasonal timing, and eclipse depth and order all vary with place.
units.literal: For fixed stars' hiding and appearing, day and night's length, the seven luminaries' rising and setting, solar terms' earliness and lateness, and eclipses' depth and sequence — all differ thereby.

units.zh: 惟得其所差之數，則各殊之故，皆可豫知，不致詫為失行而生飾說矣。
units.en: Once the correction is known, local variation is predictable and need not be mistaken for errant heavens.
units.literal: Only by obtaining the difference's number can the reasons for each difference be foreknown, so one does not marvel at seeming irregular motion and invent specious explanations.

units.zh: 新法算書所載各省北極高及東西偏度，大概據輿圖道里定之，多有未確。
units.en: Earlier manuals listed provincial polar heights and longitudinal offsets from map distances — often inaccurate.
units.literal: The New Methods Calculation Book's recorded north polar altitudes and east-west offsets for each province were largely fixed from map routes and li — many are inexact.

units.en: Here Kangxi surveys, Qianlong additions, Xinjiang, and Jinchuan observations yield revised polar altitudes and longitudinal offsets.

units.en: Even Zeng Shen, a commoner, struggled to match such devotion; you did it as heir to a kingdom—you have outdone Zeng Shen by a wide margin.

units.zh: 新法算書載西人第谷以前，或云恆星百年而東行一度，或云七十餘年而東行一度，或云六十餘年而東行一度，隨時修改，訖無定數，與古人屢改歲差相同。
units.en: Before Tycho, Westerners guessed precession at one degree per century, per seventy-odd years, or per sixty-odd—each revision unsettled, mirroring China's shifting precession rates.
units.literal: The New Methods Calculation Book records that before the Westerner Tycho some said fixed stars move east one degree in a hundred years, some in seventy-odd, some in sixty-odd—revised with the times, never settled—like the ancients' repeated changes to precession.

units.zh: 迨至第谷，方定恆星每歲東行五十一秒，約七十年有餘而行一度，而元郭守敬所定歲差之數亦為近之。
units.en: Tycho fixed annual eastward motion at 51 seconds—about one degree in seventy years—close to Guo Shoujing's Yuan rate.
units.literal: Only at Tycho was it fixed that fixed stars move east fifty-one seconds each year—about seventy-odd years for one degree—and the Yuan's Guo Shoujing's precession number is also close.

units.zh: 然則第谷所定之數，亦未可泥為定率，惟隨時測驗，依天行以推其數可也。」
units.en: Tycho's rate should not be treated as eternal; periodic measurement must track heaven's actual motion."
units.literal: Then Tycho's fixed number also cannot be taken as an immutable rate; only by measuring in season and inferring the number from heaven's motion will do."

units.zh: 十年，遭母憂，上命在任守制。
units.en: In the tenth year his mother died; the emperor permitted him to observe mourning without leaving his post.
units.literal: In the tenth year he suffered his mother's death; the emperor ordered him to observe mourning while remaining in office.

units.zh: 聖祖南巡，幸杭州，御書硃子詩及「永貞」額以賜。
units.en: During the Kangxi Emperor's southern tour, when he visited Hangzhou, he personally wrote out a poem of Zhu Xi and bestowed the plaque "Ever Faithful."
units.literal: On the Sacred Ancestor's southern tour, when he visited Hangzhou, he personally wrote a Zhu Xi poem and the plaque "Ever Faithful" as gifts.

units.zh: 諭曰：「汝父盡節，朕未嘗忘，此為汝母書也。」
units.en: He told him, "Your father died loyal to the throne, and I have never forgotten. This inscription is for your mother."
units.literal: He instructed him: "Your father died in loyalty; I have never forgotten. This inscription is for your mother."

units.zh: 上命承謨留任。
units.en: The emperor ordered Chengmo to remain in office.
units.literal: The emperor ordered Chengmo to remain in office.

units.zh: 上遣內大臣侍衛迎奠，贈兵部尚書、太子少保，諡忠貞，御書碑文賜其家。
units.en: The emperor sent an Inner Minister and guards to receive the coffin. Chengmo was posthumously made Minister of War and Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous name Zhongzhen (Loyal and Steadfast), and the emperor wrote an epitaph for his family.
units.literal: The emperor sent an Inner Minister and guards to receive the coffin; he was posthumously made Minister of War and Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, with posthumous name Zhongzhen; the emperor personally wrote an epitaph for his family.

units.zh: 承謨所為畫壁集，上親制序。
units.en: The emperor personally wrote a preface for Chengmo's collected writings from the prison walls.
units.literal: For Chengmo's collected writings from the painted walls, the emperor personally composed a preface.

units.zh: 陛辭日，上顧謂群臣曰：「此開國名臣孫，殉難忠臣子也！」
units.en: On the day he took leave of the throne, the emperor turned to the assembled ministers and said, "Here is the grandson of a founding minister and the son of a loyal martyr!"
units.literal: On the day of his farewell audience the emperor turned and said to the ministers: "This is the grandson of a founding minister and the son of a loyal martyr!"

units.zh: 建祠貴陽，上賜「勁節」二字顏其額。
units.en: A shrine was erected at Guiyang, and the emperor inscribed its tablet with the words "Steadfast Integrity."
units.literal: A shrine was built at Guiyang; the emperor bestowed the two characters "Steadfast Integrity" to inscribe its tablet.

units.zh: 總督趙廷臣請除賦額，上命承謨履勘。
units.en: Governor-General Zhao Tingchen petitioned to reduce tax quotas, and the emperor ordered Chengmo to survey the land in person.
units.literal: Governor-General Zhao Tingchen requested reduction of tax quotas; the emperor ordered Chengmo to conduct an on-site survey.

units.zh: 承謨疾未癒，命御醫診視，賜藥餌。
units.en: Chengmo had not yet recovered; the emperor sent imperial physicians and bestowed medicines.
units.literal: Chengmo's illness had not healed; the emperor ordered imperial physicians to examine him and bestowed medicines.

units.zh: 為賊困逾二年，日冠賜冠，衣辭母時衣，遇朔望，奉時憲書一帙懸之，北鄉再拜。
units.en: Imprisoned by the rebels for more than two years, he daily wore the court cap and robes the emperor had bestowed, still dressed in the clothes he had worn when taking leave of his mother. On the first and fifteenth of each month he hung up the official calendar and bowed twice toward the north.
units.literal: Held captive by the rebels for more than two years, each day he wore the court cap the emperor had granted, dressed in the clothes he wore when bidding his mother farewell; on new and full moon he hung a volume of the calendar, bowed twice toward the north.

units.zh: 福建民請建祠祀之，御書「忠貞炳日」扁於楣。
units.en: The people of Fujian petitioned for a shrine in his honor, and the emperor inscribed its lintel with the words "Loyal and Steadfast, Bright as the Sun."
units.literal: The people of Fujian requested a shrine to worship him; the emperor wrote the plaque "Loyal and Steadfast, Shining as the Sun" for its lintel.

units.zh: 上遣使護入京，至，授世濟四品京卿。
units.en: The emperor sent an escort to bring him to Beijing, and on his arrival Shiji was appointed a fourth-rank metropolitan official.
units.literal: The emperor sent an escort to bring him to the capital; on arrival Shiji was made a fourth-rank metropolitan official.

units.zh: 三桂既平，歲正，上宴群臣，特命世濟及陳啟泰子汝器至御座前賜酒。
units.en: After Sangui's rebellion was crushed, at the New Year banquet the emperor summoned Shiji and Chen Qitai's son Ruqi before the throne to receive wine in special honor.
units.literal: After Sangui was pacified, at the New Year banquet the emperor specially ordered Shiji and Chen Qitai's son Ruqi before the imperial seat to receive wine.

units.zh: 九年，上特命減死戍梧州。
units.en: In the ninth year the emperor commuted his sentence to exile at Wuzhou.
units.literal: In the ninth year the emperor specially ordered his sentence reduced to exile at Wuzhou.

units.zh: 舒恕、麻勒吉先後以聞，上嘉其忠誠，授廣西巡撫、徵蠻滅寇將軍，俾增募義兵，便宜行事。
units.en: Shushuo and Malleji reported his actions in turn. The emperor praised his loyalty, appointed him governor of Guangxi and General for Subduing Rebels and Destroying Bandits, and authorized him to recruit volunteers and act at his own discretion.
units.literal: Shushuo and Malleji reported in succession; the emperor praised his loyalty, made him governor of Guangxi and General for Subduing Barbarians and Destroying Bandits, and authorized him to recruit more volunteers and act at discretion.

units.zh: 與梁人泛言氏族，袁狎曰：「未若我本出自黃帝，姓在十四之限。」
units.en: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said, "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."
units.literal: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said: "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 六月乙亥，宋儒朱熹裔孫梃為翰林院世襲五經博士。
units.en: In the sixth month, on yihai, Ting, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhu Xi, was appointed hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, Ting, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhu Xi, was made hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 雍正間，羅馬教皇遣使來京，世宗許行西禮，且與握手。
units.en: During Yongzheng, the Pope of Rome sent envoys to the capital; the Yongzheng Emperor permitted them to use Western etiquette and even shook hands with them.
units.literal: During Yongzheng, the Pope of Rome sent envoys to the capital; the Yongzheng Emperor permitted them to use Western etiquette and even shook hands with them.

units.zh: 雍正四年，帝念四十九旗王公台吉遠至勤勞，詔改三班，二歲一朝。
units.en: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, the emperor, mindful of the long journey and labor of the princes and taiji of the forty-nine banners, decreed a change to three rotations, with audiences every two years.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, the emperor, mindful of the long journey and labor of the princes and taiji of the forty-nine banners, decreed a change to three rotations, with audiences every two years.

units.zh: 黃赤大距，古闊而今狹，恆有減而無增，西人利酌理、噶西尼測定黃赤大距二十三度二十九分，比第谷所定少二分三十秒，比刻白爾所定少一分。
units.en: The obliquity of the ecliptic was greater in antiquity and has steadily narrowed; Riccioli and Cassini measured it at 23°29′ — 2′30″ below Tycho and 1′ below Kepler.
units.literal: The great distance of yellow and red was wide in antiquity and narrow now, always decreasing never increasing; Western scholars Riccioli and Cassini measured obliquity at 23°29′, two minutes thirty seconds less than Tycho, one minute less than Kepler.

units.zh: 西人刻白爾以來，屢加精測，盈縮之最大差止一度五十六分一十二秒。
units.en: Since Kepler, repeated precision measurements have fixed the maximum equation of center at 1°56′12″.
units.literal: Since the Western scholar Kepler, through repeated fine measurement, the maximum equation-of-center difference is only 1°56′12″.

units.zh: 自西人刻白爾創橢圓之法，奈端等累測月離，得日當月天中距時最大遲疾差為四度五十七分五十七秒，兩心差為四三三一九０。
units.en: Since Kepler introduced elliptical theory, Newton and his successors measured lunar motion repeatedly: when the Sun is at the Moon's mean distance, the maximum equation is 4°57′57″ and the eccentricity 433,190.
units.literal: Since the Western scholar Kepler created the ellipse method, Newton and others cumulatively measured lunar motion; when the sun is at the moon's celestial mean distance, maximum slow-fast difference is 4°57′57″, two-center difference 433190.

units.zh: 西人刻白爾以來，奈端等屢加測驗，得日在最卑後太陰平行常遲，最高平行、正交平行常速。
units.en: Since Kepler, Newton and his successors found that after solar perigee the Moon's mean motion is consistently slow, while mean apogee and mean node motions are fast.
units.literal: Since Kepler, Newton and others repeatedly tested: after the sun is at perigee, lunar mean motion is constantly slow; apogee mean and node mean constantly fast.

units.zh: 雍正癸卯元法上
units.en: Yongzheng guimao calendrical system — upper section
units.literal: Within the Yongzheng guimao epoch system, upper section

units.zh: 又神農、桐君論《本草》藥性，黃帝、岐伯說病候治方，皆聖人之所重也。
units.en: Shennong and Lord Tong classified herbs in the Root Canon; the Yellow Emperor and Qibo set forth disease and cure—all arts the sages held dear.
units.literal: Again, Shennong and Lord Tong discussed the properties of drugs in the Root Canon of Materia Medica; the Yellow Emperor and Qibo explained symptoms and healing prescriptions—all were prized by sages.

units.zh: 十三年，高宗即位，焯疏言被水州縣不成災，上諭曰：「被水雖不成災，仍須加意賑恤，毋使小民失所。」
units.en: In 1735, when the Qianlong Emperor took the throne, Chao reported that flood-hit districts had not technically qualified as disaster areas. The emperor replied: 'Even if the floods have not risen to the level of a declared disaster, you must still relieve the people with special care and keep the poor from losing their livelihoods.'
units.literal: In the thirteenth year the Gaozong Emperor acceded; Chao memorialized that flooded prefectures and counties had not become disaster areas. The emperor instructed: 'Though flooding has not become a disaster, you must still give extra care to relief so that the common people do not lose their homes.'

units.zh: 乾隆元年，請查丈建陽民田，上諭曰：「小民畏查丈如水火。
units.en: In 1736 he asked to survey and remeasure civilian land in Jianyang. The emperor warned: 'Ordinary people fear land surveys as they fear fire and water.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he requested a survey and remeasurement of civilian fields in Jianyang. The emperor instructed: 'The common people dread surveys and remeasurements as they dread fire and flood.

units.zh: 汝初為加賦起見，今又以豁除掩非，一存觀望之心，所謂無一而可也。」
units.en: You began by trying to raise taxes, and now you propose exemptions to cover your mistakes, always hedging your bets—there is nothing in this that I can approve.'
units.literal: At first you acted with an eye to increasing levies; now you use exemptions to cover your errors, always keeping a mind of hesitation—there is nothing here that can be approved.'

units.zh: 上諭曰：「所奏各條皆是。
units.en: The emperor replied: 'Every point in your memorial is sound.
units.literal: The emperor instructed: 'Each item you have memorialized is correct.

units.zh: 汝先過刻，茲乃事事以寬沽名。
units.en: You used to be excessively harsh; now you court popularity by leniency on every issue.
units.literal: You were formerly too severe; now on every matter you use leniency to buy a reputation.

units.zh: 過猶不及，汝其識之！」
units.en: Excess is no better than deficiency—remember that!'
units.literal: To go too far is as bad as not going far enough—mark this well!'

units.zh: 五年，上諭曰：「盧焯至浙江，沽名邀譽，舉鄉賢名宦，絡繹不絕。
units.en: In 1740 the emperor said: 'Since Lu Chao arrived in Zhejiang he has been currying favor, nominating local worthies and celebrated officials in an endless stream.
units.literal: In the fifth year the emperor instructed: 'Since Lu Chao reached Zhejiang he has courted reputation and sought praise, recommending local worthies and famous officials without cease.

units.zh: 海塘外已漲沙數十里，焯既請停草塘歲修，又請改建石塘。
units.en: Sand had already built up for dozens of li beyond the seawall, yet Chao first asked to halt annual repairs to the earthen dike and then asked to rebuild it in stone.
units.literal: Outside the seawall sand had already accreted for several tens of li; Chao had both requested stopping annual sod-wall repairs and requested rebuilding as a stone seawall.

units.zh: 心無定見，惟事揣摩，已彰明較著矣。」
units.en: He has no settled judgment and only tries to guess what I want—this is already perfectly obvious.'
units.literal: His mind has no fixed view; he only guesses at what is wanted—this is already glaringly clear.'

units.zh: 上諭曰：「圖爾炳阿察出逆檄，緝邪之功大，諱災之罪小。
units.en: The emperor said: 'Tu Erbing'a uncovered the seditious proclamation; his merit in rooting out sedition is great, and his offense in concealing the disaster is small.
units.literal: The emperor instructed: 'Tu Erbing'a uncovered the treasonous proclamation—his merit in suppressing heterodoxy is great, his offense in concealing the disaster is small.

units.zh: 且以如此梗不知化之民，而治其司牧者以罪，是不益長澆風乎？
units.en: And for subjects this stubborn and unreformed, to punish their magistrates instead—would that not only encourage moral decay?
units.literal: Moreover, for such stubborn and unregenerate commoners, to punish their local officials—would this not only encourage a degenerate trend?

units.zh: 免圖爾炳阿罪，仍留巡撫任治賑。
units.en: Tu Erbing'a was pardoned and kept in office as governor to oversee relief.
units.literal: Tu Erbing'a's punishment was remitted and he was retained in the governorship to manage relief.

units.zh: 圖爾炳阿若因有前此罪斥之旨，心存成見，或不釋然於災民，則是自取罪戾，亦不能逃朕洞鑑。」
units.en: If Tu Erbing'a, remembering my earlier rebuke, holds a grudge or takes out his resentment on the flood victims, he will bring punishment on himself—and he cannot escape my scrutiny.'
units.literal: If Tu Erbing'a, because of the earlier edict rebuking him, harbors prejudice or is not reconciled to the disaster victims, then he brings punishment on himself and cannot escape My penetrating scrutiny.'

units.zh: 上諭之曰：「賑濟蠲緩，重者數百萬，少亦數十萬，悉動正帑，從無顧惜。
units.en: The emperor told him: 'Relief, tax remission, and deferments cost millions in the worst cases and hundreds of thousands in the least—all paid from the regular treasury without hesitation.
units.literal: The emperor instructed him: 'For relief, tax remission, and deferment, the heavy cases run to several millions and the light to several hundreds of thousands—all drawn from the regular treasury without stint.

units.zh: 富戶所捐幾何，貯庫助賑，殊非體制。
units.en: What can wealthy donors really contribute? Storing private donations in the treasury for relief is entirely improper.
units.literal: How much can wealthy households donate? To store it in the treasury to aid relief is quite contrary to proper practice.

units.zh: 此端一開，則偏災之地，貧民既苦艱食，富戶又令出貲。
units.en: Once that door is opened, in every partial disaster the poor already go hungry while the rich are pressed for money too.
units.literal: Once this precedent is opened, in locally stricken areas the poor already suffer from scarce food and the wealthy are again ordered to pay out funds.

units.zh: 國家撫卹災黎，何忍出此？」
units.en: When the state relieves disaster victims, how can we stoop to such a scheme?'
units.literal: When the state comforts and relieves disaster victims, how can we bear to resort to this?'

units.zh: 兆麟復奏請簡發知府三員赴貴州，上以「此端一開，各省效尤，妨吏部選法；
units.en: Zhaolin then asked that three prefects be specially sent to Guizhou. The emperor warned: 'Open that door and every province will follow, undermining the Board's appointment system;
units.literal: Zhaolin again memorialized requesting that three prefects be specially dispatched to Guizhou; the emperor said: 'Once this precedent is opened, every province will follow suit and obstruct the Board's appointment methods;

units.zh: 且開幸進之門」，下旨嚴飭。
units.en: and it opens a path for favor-seekers.' A stern edict followed.'
units.literal: moreover it opens a gate to lucky advancement,' and issued a stern edict of rebuke.'

units.zh: 上曰：「觀音保人已粗率，今尚以兆麟為粗率，則粗率更甚可知。」
units.en: The emperor said: 'Guanyinbao is already a rough man; if even he finds Zhaolin crude, Zhaolin must be rougher still.'
units.literal: The emperor said: 'Guanyinbao is already crude and reckless; if he still finds Zhaolin crude and reckless, then Zhaolin must be cruder still, as one can infer.'

units.zh: 上諭曰：「得雨二三寸未為霑足，焉能種雜糧？
units.en: The emperor replied: 'Two or three inches of rain is not enough to soak the fields—how can anyone plant secondary crops?
units.literal: The emperor instructed: 'Two or three inches of rain is not sufficient soaking—how can miscellaneous grains be planted?

units.zh: 地方雨水，民瘼攸關。
units.en: Local rainfall is a matter of the people's welfare.
units.literal: Local rainfall is intimately tied to the people's suffering.

units.zh: 鶚元何得含混入告？」
units.en: How can Eyuan blur the truth in his reports?'
units.literal: How can Eyuan mingle truth and falsehood in his reports?'

units.zh: 高宗常謂：「朕非甚懦弱姑息之主，不能執法。」
units.en: The Qianlong Emperor often said: 'I am not so weak and indulgent that I cannot enforce the law.'
units.literal: The Gaozong Emperor often said: 'I am not a very weak and indulgent ruler who cannot enforce the law.'

units.zh: 六年，左都御史劉吳龍劾焯營私受賄，上解焯任，命總督德沛、副都統旺扎爾按治，事皆實，請奪官刑訊。
units.en: In 1741 Left Censor-in-chief Liu Wulong accused Chao of corruption and bribery. The emperor removed him from office and ordered Governor-general Depè and Vice Banner Commander Wangzhar to investigate; every charge was proved, and they recommended stripping his rank and putting him to the question.
units.literal: In the sixth year Left Censor-in-chief Liu Wulong impeached Chao for private dealings and taking bribes. The emperor relieved Chao of his post and ordered Governor-general Depè and Vice Banner Commander Wangzhar to investigate; the charges were all substantiated, and they requested deprivation of office and interrogation under torture.

units.zh: 德沛等以聞，上諭責辦理不妥。
units.en: Depè reported the incident, and the emperor rebuked them for mishandling the case.
units.literal: Depè and the others reported this; the emperor instructed and rebuked them for improper handling.

units.zh: 十六年，上南巡，閱海塘，念焯勞，召還。
units.en: In 1751, on a southern tour, the emperor inspected the seawall, remembered Chao's service, and recalled him.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, during the emperor's southern tour, he inspected the seawall and, recalling Chao's labors, summoned him back.

units.zh: 宏謀未至，上命發歸化城米運金川饋軍，急驛諭宏謀。
units.en: Before Hongmou arrived, the throne ordered grain from Guihua City shipped to supply the Jinchuan campaign and sent an urgent courier to inform Hongmou.
units.literal: Before Hongmou arrived, the emperor ordered grain from Guihua City sent to provision the army in Jinchuan, urgently dispatching a courier to instruct Hongmou.

units.zh: 上嘉焯知大體，合機宜，實授湖北巡撫。
units.en: The emperor praised Chao for understanding the larger situation and acting appropriately, and confirmed him as governor of Hubei.
units.literal: The emperor praised Chao for grasping the larger situation and fitting the occasion, and formally appointed him governor of Hubei.

units.zh: 上責焯負恩，奪官，戍巴里坤。
units.en: The emperor accused Chao of betraying his favor, stripped his rank, and exiled him to Barkol.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked Chao for ingratitude, stripped his office, and banished him to Barkol.

units.zh: 總督碩色論劾，上責圖爾炳阿欺隱徇庇，奪官，逮京師，下刑部治罪，坐監守自盜，擬斬監候。
units.en: Governor-general Shuose memorialized against him; the emperor condemned Tu Erbing'a for covering up the case and showing favoritism, stripped his rank, had him brought to Beijing, and referred him to the Board of Punishments, which convicted him of custodial embezzlement and sentenced him to beheading, commuted after review.
units.literal: Governor-general Shuose impeached him in a memorial; the emperor rebuked Tu Erbing'a for concealment and favoritism, stripped his office, had him arrested and brought to the capital, and handed him to the Board of Punishments, which convicted him of custodial theft and sentenced him to beheading after the autumn assizes.

units.zh: 十七年，上以圖爾炳阿贓未入己，釋出獄。
units.en: In 1752 the emperor ruled that Tu Erbing'a had not personally profited from the shortfall and released him from prison.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year the emperor, because Tu Erbing'a's illicit gains had not entered his own pocket, released him from prison.

units.zh: 二十二年，上南巡，江蘇布政使夏邑彭家屏以病告家居，覲徐州行在，入對，言鄉縣被水。
units.en: In 1757, on the emperor's southern tour, Jiangsu treasurer Peng Jiaping of Xiayi, who had retired on grounds of illness, came to the traveling palace at Xuzhou, was granted an audience, and reported flooding in his home district.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, during the emperor's southern tour, Jiangsu treasurer Peng Jiaping of Xiayi, having reported illness and retired home, presented himself at the traveling palace in Xuzhou, was received in audience, and said his home county had suffered flooding.

units.zh: 上諮圖爾炳阿，圖爾炳阿奏收成至九分，上責圖爾炳阿文過。
units.en: The emperor asked Tu Erbing'a, who reported a harvest of ninety percent; the emperor rebuked him for whitewashing the situation.
units.literal: The emperor consulted Tu Erbing'a; Tu Erbing'a memorialized that the harvest reached nine-tenths, and the emperor rebuked him for glossing over faults.

units.zh: 圖爾炳阿又奏「去歲被水尚未成災」，上斥為怙惡不悛。
units.en: Tu Erbing'a then reported that 'last year's floods have not yet amounted to a disaster,' and the emperor denounced him as incorrigible.
units.literal: Tu Erbing'a again memorialized that 'last year's flooding has not yet become a disaster,' and the emperor denounced him as persisting in evil without repentance.

units.zh: 遣員外郎觀音保密察災狀得實，上奪圖爾炳阿官，髮烏里雅蘇台效力。
units.en: He sent Vice Director Guanyinbao to investigate in secret and confirmed the disaster. The emperor stripped Tu Erbing'a of his rank and sent him to serve at Uliastai.
units.literal: He dispatched Vice Director Guanyinbao to investigate secretly; the disaster conditions were found true. The emperor stripped Tu Erbing'a of office and sent him to serve at Uliastai.

units.zh: 上發徐州，夏邑民張欽、劉元德詣行在訴知縣孫默諱災及治賑不實，上親鞫，元德言諸生段昌緒指使。
units.en: As the emperor left Xuzhou, Xiayi residents Zhang Qin and Liu Yuande came to the traveling palace to accuse Magistrate Sun Mo of concealing the disaster and bungling relief. The emperor questioned them personally, and Yuande said the student Duan Changxu had put them up to it.
units.literal: As the emperor departed Xuzhou, Xiayi commoners Zhang Qin and Liu Yuande came to the traveling palace to accuse Magistrate Sun Mo of concealing the disaster and mishandling relief; the emperor personally examined them, and Yuande said the licentiate Duan Changxu had instigated them.

units.zh: 上復遣侍衛成林會圖爾炳阿至夏邑按治，於昌緒家得傳鈔吳三桂檄。
units.en: The emperor again sent Bodyguard Cheng Lin with Tu Erbing'a to investigate in Xiayi, where they found copied proclamations of Wu Sangui in Changxu's house.
units.literal: The emperor again dispatched Bodyguard Cheng Lin to join Tu Erbing'a in going to Xiayi to investigate; at Changxu's home they found circulated copies of a proclamation of Wu Sangui.

units.zh: 上嘉其言得要。
units.en: The emperor praised his advice as sound.
units.literal: The emperor praised his words as hitting the essential point.

units.zh: 學政謝溶生劾阿思哈婪賄派累，命尚書劉統勳、侍郎常鈞等按鞫，得實，擬絞。
units.en: Provincial education commissioner Xie Rongsheng impeached Asiha for extortion and corrupt levies. The emperor ordered Minister Liu Tongxun, Vice Minister Chang Jun, and others to investigate; the charges proved true and strangulation was recommended.
units.literal: The provincial education commissioner Xie Rongsheng impeached Asiha for greedily accepting bribes and imposing burdensome levies; the emperor ordered Ministers Liu Tongxun and Vice Minister Chang Jun and others to investigate and try the case; the charges were found true, and strangulation was proposed.

units.zh: 上責其畏難，解任，以副都統銜在領隊大臣上行走。
units.en: The emperor accused him of shrinking from hardship, removed him from office, and assigned him to serve under the expedition commander with assistant commandant's rank.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked him for fearing hardship; he was dismissed from office and, with the rank of assistant commandant, was ordered to serve under the expedition commander.

units.zh: 旋召為吏部侍郎，入對失上指，奪官，戍伊犁。
units.en: He was soon recalled as vice minister of the Board of Civil Appointments, but in audience he displeased the emperor, was stripped of rank, and exiled to Ili.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was summoned as vice minister of the Board of Civil Appointments; in audience he missed the emperor's intent; his office was stripped and he was exiled to Ili.

units.zh: 阿思哈初撫江西，上眷之獨厚。
units.en: When Asiha first governed Jiangxi, the emperor favored him unusually.
units.literal: When Asiha first served as governor of Jiangxi, the emperor favored him with special warmth.

units.zh: 廣西巡撫衛哲治入覲，上問各省督撫孰為最劣，哲治引罪，上謂：「姑置汝！」
units.en: When Guangxi governor Wei Zhezhi came to court, the emperor asked who among the provincial governors was the worst. Zhezhi took the blame himself. The emperor said: 'Never mind you for now—'
units.literal: Guangxi governor Wei Zhezhi came to audience; the emperor asked which governor or governor-general in the provinces was worst; Zhezhi pleaded guilty; the emperor said: 'Leave you aside for now!'

units.zh: 上遣侍郎期成額會總督定長按治，如兆麟讞；
units.en: The emperor sent Vice Minister Qicheng'e with Governor-General Ding Chang to investigate; the case followed Zhaolin's findings;
units.literal: The emperor dispatched Vice Minister Qicheng'e to join Governor-General Ding Chang in investigating and handling the case according to Zhaolin's verdict;

units.zh: 雲南軍營需硝，敕兆麟籌畫，兆麟以廣西舊存硝七萬七千餘斤運剝隘，复撥通省營貯火藥二十萬斤繼運，得旨嘉許。
units.en: When Yunnan's military camps needed saltpeter, the emperor ordered Zhaolin to arrange supply. He shipped over 77,000 jin of saltpeter stored in Guangxi to Bo'ai, then forwarded 200,000 jin of gunpowder from Guangxi arsenals. The emperor praised the effort.
units.literal: Yunnan's military camps needed saltpeter; an edict ordered Zhaolin to plan supplies; Zhaolin shipped more than seventy-seven thousand jin of saltpeter previously stored in Guangxi to Bo'ai, then allocated two hundred thousand jin of gunpowder stored in camps province-wide for continued transport; an approving edict was received.

units.zh: 上斥其冒昧，勗令詳慎。
units.en: The emperor rebuked his impulsiveness and urged greater care.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked his rashness and urged him to be thorough and cautious.

units.zh: 四十一年，東巡，兆麟迎駕，詔與三品銜。
units.en: During the emperor's 1776 eastern tour, Zhaolin met the procession and was granted third-rank insignia.
units.literal: In the forty-first year, during the eastern tour, Zhaolin met the imperial procession and was granted third-rank insignia by edict.

units.zh: 上命景素具車馬濟師，令分守河西。
units.en: The emperor ordered Jingsu to supply transport for the army and hold the west bank of the river.
units.literal: The emperor ordered Jingsu to provide carts and horses to aid the army and commanded him to hold the west bank of the river separately.

units.zh: 四十一年，上東巡，臨視臨清毀橋斷道及亂民竄據所在，景素述當時戰狀，上嘉其勞，賜黃馬褂。
units.en: During the 1776 eastern tour the emperor inspected Linqing, where bridges had been destroyed and rebels had held ground. Jingsu described the fighting; the emperor praised his service and granted him a yellow jacket.
units.literal: In the forty-first year, during the emperor's eastern tour, he personally viewed the destroyed bridges and severed roads at Linqing and where rebels had lurked; Jingsu narrated the fighting at the time; the emperor praised his labors and granted a yellow jacket.

units.zh: 得旨嘉獎。
units.en: The emperor approved and commended the plan.
units.literal: An approving edict was received with commendation.

units.zh: 薦於易簡為布政使，上以易簡為大學士敏中弟，責景素。
units.en: He recommended Yu Yijian as treasurer, but the emperor rebuked him because Yijian was the younger brother of Grand Secretary Minzhong.
units.literal: He recommended Yu Yijian for provincial treasurer; the emperor, since Yijian was the younger brother of Grand Secretary Minzhong, rebuked Jingsu.

units.zh: 鶚元窺上指欲寬侍堯，獨奏言：「侍堯歷任封疆，勤幹有為，中外推服。
units.en: Eyuan sensed that the emperor wished to spare Shiyao and alone memorialized: 'Shiyao has served on the frontiers with diligence and ability, and is respected throughout the bureaucracy.
units.literal: Eyuan divined that the emperor wished to be lenient toward Shiyao and alone memorialized: 'Shiyao has served on the frontiers, diligent and capable, admired within and without.

units.zh: 上從之，侍堯得復起。
units.en: The emperor agreed, and Shiyao was restored to office.
units.literal: The emperor assented, and Shiyao was able to rise again.

units.zh: 上責鶚元隱忍瞻徇，知其事而不舉，降三品頂戴，停廉俸。
units.en: The emperor rebuked Eyuan for covering up the affair and showing favoritism—he had known but not reported it. His rank insignia was reduced to third grade and his integrity stipend suspended.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked Eyuan for concealment and favoritism, knowing of the matter yet not reporting it; his insignia was reduced to third rank and his integrity stipend suspended.

units.zh: 上諮鶚元，鶚元猶庇瑍不以實陳，乃遣尚書慶桂、侍郎王昶按治；
units.en: The emperor questioned Eyuan, who still shielded Yin and did not tell the truth. The emperor then sent Minister Qinggui and Vice Minister Wang Chang to investigate;
units.literal: The emperor questioned Eyuan; Eyuan still shielded Yin and did not report truthfully, whereupon Minister Qinggui and Vice Minister Wang Chang were dispatched to investigate;

units.zh: 上責鶚元玩視民瘼，徇情骫法，命置重典。
units.en: The emperor condemned Eyuan for neglecting the people's welfare and bending the law out of favoritism, and ordered severe punishment.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked Eyuan for treating the people's suffering lightly and bending the law out of personal favor, ordering severe punishment.

units.zh: 獄具，擬斬立決，命改監候。
units.en: The verdict recommended immediate execution; the emperor commuted the sentence to imprisonment pending review.
units.literal: When the case was concluded, immediate decapitation was recommended; the emperor ordered commutation to imprisonment awaiting autumn review.

units.zh: 圖爾炳阿匿災至面謾，反誅告者；
units.en: Tu Erbing'a concealed a disaster even to the emperor's face, yet those who reported it were punished;
units.literal: Tu Erbing'a concealed disaster to the point of deceiving the emperor face to face, yet those who reported it were punished instead;

units.zh: 兆麟口給，鶚元迎上指，至不勝疆政而始去之。
units.en: Zhaolin was glib, Eyuan read the emperor's mind—only when they proved unfit for frontier rule were they finally removed.
units.literal: Zhaolin was glib of tongue, Eyuan courted the emperor's intent—only when they could no longer bear frontier governance were they removed.

units.zh: 宋程顥雲，'古者人君必有誦訓箴諫之臣'。
units.en: Cheng Hao of the Song said, 'In ancient times every ruler had ministers who recited lessons and offered frank remonstrance.'
units.literal: Song Cheng Hao said, 'In antiquity the ruler must have ministers who recite admonitions and offer remonstrance.'

units.zh: 會通程、硃、陸、王學說，無所偏主，要以克己復禮、身體實行為歸。
units.en: He mastered the teachings of the Cheng brothers, Zhu Xi, Lu Xiangshan, and Wang Yangming without partisan bias, and aimed always at self-restraint, return to ritual, and practice in the flesh.
units.literal: He comprehended the teachings of Cheng, Zhu, Lu, and Wang without partial adherence, taking self-restraint and return to ritual and bodily practice as his aim.

units.zh: 因詢廷棟讀何書，廷棟以程、硃對。
units.en: The emperor asked what he read; Wu Tingdong answered, the Cheng brothers and Zhu Xi.
units.literal: He then asked what books Tingdong read; Tingdong answered, Cheng and Zhu.

units.zh: 程、硃以明德為體，新民為用，天下未有有體而無用者。
units.en: Cheng and Zhu take illustrious virtue as root and renewing the people as use; nowhere is there root without use.
units.literal: Cheng and Zhu take illustrious virtue as substance and renewing the people as function; under Heaven there has never been substance without function.

units.zh: 文宗即位，應詔陳言，略曰：「行政莫先於用人，用人莫先於君子小人之辨。
units.en: When the Xianfeng Emperor acceded, Wo Ren answered an imperial call for counsel with a memorial that began: 'In governing, nothing precedes the choice of men; in choosing men, nothing precedes telling the gentleman from the petty man.
units.literal: When Emperor Wenzong took the throne, in response to an edict he submitted a memorial, stating in part: 'In administration nothing comes before employing men; in employing men nothing comes before distinguishing gentlemen from petty men.

units.zh: 上曰：「學程、硃者每多迂拘。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Students of Cheng and Zhu are often stiff and narrow."
units.literal: The Emperor said: 'Those who study Cheng and Zhu are often rigid and constrained.'

units.zh: 噶西尼反覆精求，謂視線光線所歧雖有不同，相合則有定處。
units.en: Cassini, after painstaking inquiry, showed that however much the sight line and light ray diverge, their point of convergence is fixed.
units.literal: Cassini, through repeated refinement, said that although the divergence of sight line and light ray differs, where they meet has a fixed place.

units.zh: 康熙十一年壬子秒分前十四日夜半，火星與太陽沖，西人噶西尼於富郎濟亞國測得火星距天頂五十九度四十分一十五秒，利實爾於同一子午線之噶耶那島測得火星距天頂一十五度四十七分五秒，同時用有千里鏡能測秒微之儀器，與子午線上最近一恆星，測其相距。
units.en: On the night fourteen days before the Kangxi 11 renzi epoch mark, at Mars's opposition, Cassini in France measured Mars at 59°40′15″ from the zenith while Richer on Cayenne, on the same meridian, found 15°47′5″; both used telescopic instruments precise to the second and measured each planet's distance from the nearest meridian star.
units.literal: Kangxi 11, year renzi, fourteen days before the midnight of the second-fraction, Mars in opposition with the sun; Cassini in France measured Mars's distance from zenith 59°40′15″, Richer on Cayenne Island on the same meridian measured Mars's distance from zenith 15°47′5″; at the same time using instruments with telescopes able to measure seconds and micro-units, with the nearest fixed star on the meridian, measuring their separation.

units.zh: 噶西尼所得火星較低一十五秒，因恆星無地半徑差以之立法，用平三角形，推得火星在地平上最大地半徑差二十五秒，小餘三七。
units.en: Cassini's Mars appeared 15″ lower; since fixed stars show no parallax, they used plane triangles to derive Mars's maximum horizon parallax as 25.37″.
units.literal: Cassini's Mars was lower by fifteen seconds; because fixed stars have no diurnal parallax, establishing law thereby, using plane triangles, Mars's maximum diurnal parallax at the horizon was derived as 25″, remainder 37.

units.zh: 噶西尼等乃立角積相求諸法，驗諸實測，斯為菂合。
units.en: Cassini and his colleagues devised methods relating angle and area that matched observation exactly.
units.literal: Cassini and others then established methods of mutual angle-area seeking; verified against actual measurement, this fit precisely.

units.zh: 西人噶西尼等測得每歲平行一分二秒五十九微五十一纖零八忽，比甲子元法多一秒四十九微有奇。
units.en: Cassini measured the annual advance of perigee at 1′2″59.51‴08, slightly more than 1″49‴ above the jiazi epoch system.
units.literal: Western scholars Cassini and others measured annual mean motion 1′2″59‴51 fibres 08 hū, a little more than 1″49‴ above the jiazi epoch method.

units.zh: 用西人噶西尼所定，推得雍正癸卯年天正冬至為丙申日丑正三刻十一分有奇，比甲子元法遲二刻。
units.en: From Cassini's constants, the winter solstice of Yongzheng guimao falls on day bingshen at the third quarter of the chou watch — about two quarters later than the jiazi epoch system.
units.literal: Using Cassini's Western determination, the Yongzheng guimao year first-month winter solstice is derived as day bingshen, chou hour third quarter eleven minutes odd, two quarters later than the jiazi epoch method.

units.zh: 西人噶西尼以來，屢加測驗，定日在最高朔望前後四十五度，最大差為三十三分一十四秒；
units.en: Cassini's observations fix the maximum second inequality at 33′14″ when the Sun is at apogee and 45° from syzygy;
units.literal: Since Cassini, through repeated testing: fixing when the sun is at apogee, forty-five degrees before and after new and full moon, maximum difference is 33′14″;

units.zh: 西人噶西尼以來，取月距日與月高距日高共為九十度時測之，除末均之差外，其差與月距日或月高距日高之獨為九十度者等。
units.en: Cassini found that when the sum of the Moon's elongation and the separation of their apogees equals 90°, the correction—aside from the final inequality—equals that when either alone is 90°.
units.literal: Since Cassini, measuring when moon's distance from sun and moon's apogee distance from solar apogee together total ninety degrees: aside from the final-equation difference, the difference equals when moon's distance from sun or moon's apogee distance from solar apogee alone is ninety degrees.

units.zh: 西人噶西尼以來，測日月最高同度或日月同度兩者只有一相距之差，則止有三均。
units.en: Cassini found that when the solar and lunar apogees coincide, or when the Sun and Moon share the same longitude with only one separation variable, three inequalities suffice.
units.literal: Since Cassini, measuring when sun and moon apogees are same degree or sun and moon same degree with only one separation difference, then only three equations apply.

units.zh: 西人奈端、噶西尼以來，測得日在兩交時，交角最大為五度一十七分二十秒；
units.en: Newton and Cassini measured the maximum node angle at 5°17′20″ when the Sun is at the nodes;
units.literal: Since Newton and Cassini, measured when the sun is at the two nodes, node angle maximum is 5°17′20″;

units.zh: 爰在北極出地高四十四度處，屢加精測，得地平上最大差為三十二分一十九秒，蒙氣之厚為地半徑千萬分之六千零九十五，視線角與光線角正弦之比例，常如一千萬與一千萬零二千八百四十一。
units.en: At latitude 44°, repeated precision measurements yielded a maximum horizon refraction of 32′19″, an atmospheric thickness of 6,095 parts per ten million of Earth's radius, and a constant sine ratio of 10,000,000 to 10,002,841 between the sight and light angles.
units.literal: Thereupon at a place where the north pole rises forty-four degrees above the horizon, through repeated fine measurement, the maximum difference at the horizon was obtained as 32′19″; atmospheric thickness as 6,095 per ten million of earth radius; the ratio of sines of sight angle and light angle constantly as 10,000,000 to 10,002,841.

units.zh: 自地心過所合處作線抵圓周，即為蒙氣割線。
units.en: A line from Earth's center through that point to the limb defines the refraction secant.
units.literal: Drawing a line from the geocenter through the meeting point to the circumference is the atmospheric refraction secant.

units.zh: 視線與割線成一角，光線與割線亦成一角，二角相減，得蒙氣差角。
units.en: The angle between the sight line and the secant, minus that between the light ray and the secant, gives the refraction correction.
units.literal: The sight line forms an angle with the secant, the light ray also forms an angle with the secant; subtracting the two angles yields the atmospheric-refraction angle.

units.zh: 用是推得逐度蒙氣差。
units.en: From these constants the refraction at every altitude was derived.
units.literal: Using this, refraction for each degree was derived.

units.zh: 又據歌白尼、第谷測得火星距地與太陽距地之比，如一百與二百六十六，用轉比例法，求得太陽在中距時地平上最大地半徑差一十秒，其逐度之差，以半徑與正弦為比例。
units.en: From Copernicus and Tycho's ratio of Mars's distance to the Sun's (100:266), they derived the Sun's maximum horizon parallax at mean distance as 10″, with degree-by-degree values proportional to radius and sine.
units.literal: Also according to Copernicus and Tycho's measurement of the ratio of Mars's distance from earth to sun's distance from earth, as 100 to 266, using conversion proportion, the sun's maximum diurnal parallax at horizon at mean distance was obtained as 10″; differences for each degree use radius and sine as proportion.

units.zh: 本法用之，以求地半徑與日天半徑之比例，中距為一與二萬零六百二十六，最高為一與二萬零九百七十五，最卑為一與二萬零二百七十七，地平上最大地半徑差最高為九秒五十微，最卑為一十秒一十微。
units.en: The present method adopts this to fix the ratio of Earth's radius to the Sun's distance: 1:20,626 at mean distance, 1:20,975 at apogee, 1:20,277 at perigee; maximum horizon parallax 9″50‴ at apogee and 10″10‴ at perigee.
units.literal: This method uses it to seek the ratio of earth radius to solar celestial radius: at mean distance 1 to 20,626, at apogee 1 to 20,975, at perigee 1 to 20,277; maximum horizon diurnal parallax at apogee 9″50‴, at perigee 10″10‴.

units.zh: 乃將月高距日高九十度分為九限，各於月距日九十度時測之，兩高相距九十度，其差三分；
units.en: The arc between apogees at 90° was divided into nine steps and measured when the Moon was also at 90° elongation: at 90° separation the correction is 3′;
units.literal: Then dividing moon's apogee distance from solar apogee at ninety degrees into nine limits, each measured when moon's distance from sun is ninety degrees: two apogees separated ninety degrees, difference three minutes;

units.zh: 邵繼祖，洛陽人，先賢康節公邵子二十七代孫也。
units.en: Shao Jizu, from Luoyang, was a twenty-seventh-generation descendant of Shao Yong, the former worthy Lord Kangjie.
units.literal: Shao Jizu, a native of Luoyang, was a descendant of the former worthy Lord Kangjie, Master Shao, in the twenty-seventh generation.

units.zh: 崇禎三年，河南巡按吳甡請以繼祖為翰林院《五經》博士，子孫世襲，以奉邵子祀事。
units.en: In Chongzhen 3 Henan touring censor Wu Shen asked that Jizu be made Hanlin Doctor of the Five Classics, hereditary for his line, to oversee sacrifices to Shao Yong.
units.literal: In the third year of Chongzhen Henan touring censor Wu Shen requested that Jizu be made Doctor of the Five Classics in the Hanlin Academy, hereditary for his descendants, to perform sacrifices to Master Shao.

units.zh: 西人多錄某測得金星當地平，太陽在地平下五度；
units.en: The Westerner Duolumou (Ptolemy) found that when Venus is on the horizon, the sun is 5° below it;
units.literal: The Westerner Duolumou measured: Venus at the horizon when the sun is 5° below;

units.zh: 木星水星當地平，太陽在地平下十度；
units.en: Jupiter and Mercury at 10°;
units.literal: Jupiter and Mercury at 10°;

units.zh: 土星當地平，太陽在地平下十一度；
units.en: Saturn at 11°;
units.literal: Saturn at 11°;

units.zh: 火星當地平，太陽在地平下十一度三十分；
units.en: Mars at 11°30′;
units.literal: Mars at 11°30′;

units.zh: 為星見之限。
units.en: as the limits of planetary visibility.
units.literal: as the limit for visibility.

units.zh: 至宋儒程頤乃始約之而歸於四世，自公卿以及士庶，莫不皆然。
units.en: Only the Song Confucian Cheng Yi began to reduce it and return it to four generations; from dukes and ministers down to scholars and commoners, none differed.
units.literal: Only the Song Confucian Cheng Yi began to reduce it and return it to four generations; from dukes and ministers down to scholars and commoners, none differed.

units.zh: 謂五服之制，皆至高祖，則祭亦當如之。
units.en: He held that because the five-garment mourning system all reaches to the great-great-grandfather, sacrifice should likewise do so.
units.literal: He held that because the five-garment mourning system all reaches to the great-great-grandfather, sacrifice should likewise do so.
